items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: And we had Jimmy Noon on clarinet, Papa Mudd on trumpet.

ctx.x: I know Stan at all, I think, put up the money. I know the program. I got tapes of it.
Well, that's who we was playing for. And we had Jimmy Noon on clarinet, Papa Mudd on trumpet. No Papa Mudd.

items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: Was on drums. Ah, Jimmy Noon, Zully, Zootie, ah, ah, who was playing the piano now?

ctx.x: 42, that's right. So, in other words, the Mutt Corey Ory and Dorensbourg Dorensbourg, front line, how long did that stay together?
Mutt stayed with us, up there with the band, clean up till -- let me see, get that thing right. We was playing for Orson Welles Welles, remember?
